class_guess: Bell eats counter (BMO 7 layout, but a base-3 counter)
summary: BMO7-like bell + walking marker; counter is base 3, not binary; the eat step rebuilds it irregularly
mechanism: Tape = a long 10-sea (the bell) + a short counter at its right end; a marker walks right through the bell.
Each bounce adds 1 to the base-3 counter: a digit = a wall at offset 1/2/3 in its frame; overflow appends a digit.
When the marker hits the counter, the bell eats its low end (grows by g >= 2); g and the new counter depend only on it.

W as wall gaps (o = 00 hole, # = 11 bump)

rules.name: Inc (one bounce, X form)
rules.cases: b>=1. X(v) = D(v mod 3) 1 T(v div 3) 001; D = 0010|0110|0100; T = bijective base-3 digits LSB first, 1/2/3 = 0001/0011/0010

rules.name: Inc (one bounce, any frames)
rules.cases: b>=1. F = frames (d_i in 1..3, even width w_i>=4), wall gaps 1,d_0,w_0-d_0,...; inc = base 3 on d (3->1 carries), overflow appends (1,4); widths unchanged

template.note: Left bell bounce (BMO7 LIncs) holds here 36/36; binary RInc fails on every odd counter (16/40), BigStep shape 3/8 with non-binary right side. Same layout, new counter.

strategy: Keep BMO7's layout: Longitudinal sideRLs for bell bounces (reuse LIncs), a new ternary Inc lemma over frames (ind on digits, DivModCases mod 3). Next stage: close the Eat step by enumerating reachable counter shapes; if finite-parametric, prove it with a WF invariant + progress_nonhalt_cond (BMO7 pattern), else a verified checker over frame lists.
risks: Eat step not closed: phase-start counters irregular (dN 1 in ~half of phases, else 4..38).
If eat outcomes depend on counter digits pseudo-randomly, this becomes a cryptid-like case.
Larger than BMO7 (441 lines): two-level counter + eat lemma family; likely >15 KB.
